nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: [You defeated the final boss. The darkness retreats. But something else stirs—something older. Something that was waiting.]

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: [A shadow peels itself from the wall of the Void Spire. It has no face. It has all faces. It knows your name.]

nodes.speaker: The Architect
nodes.text: You destroyed my tool. How inconvenient. I suppose I'll have to handle this myself.

nodes.speaker: The Architect
nodes.text: The reason there will always be kobolds.
